description: Pancake Prediction Market provides a platform for users to bet on the outcomes of various events, starting with the Euro 2024 football matches. The platform utilizes PancakeSwap V4 hooks to dynamically adjust liquidity based on real-time data fetched from a pull-based oracle. This setup ensures a fair, transparent, and engaging user experience.
how_its_made: The project leverages the PancakeSwap V4 hooks for dynamic liquidity management and a custom pull-based oracle to fetch and update real-time event data. The odds and liquidity adjustments are calculated using mathematical functions integrated with the smart contracts to ensure precision and fairness.
